meaning: Watcher-dropout and Gram rank-deficiency audit benchmark under StreamingGramProbeMonitor and StreamingWatcherDropoutGramAuditMonitor across 5 model families on 4x3 watcher matrix Q: separates redundant row-1 dropout (preserving rank(Q_{-1}^T Q_{-1}) = 3 and ||Q_{-1} v_crit||_2^2 = 4 > 0 -> L = 1, E_g = 1, Delta_E = 0) from critical row-3 dropout (reducing rank(Q_{-3}^T Q_{-3}) from 3 to 2 and enlarging ker(Q_{-3}^T Q_{-3}) to include v_crit = [1, -1, 1] with ||Q_{-3} v_crit||_2^2 = 0 -> L = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1).
